timeline.claim: The presenter described a prior tight-range trade that did not reach its 6% target, reversed, and was cut at an approximate 25% loss. The source gave no verifiable contract, timestamp, fill, or market-data record for that outcome.

The session identified `606` calls as the pick of the day and indicated that the pick was distributed at the beginning of the session. The recording does not establish the entry, exit, target hit, or P&L for that pick.

Near the end, the source stated that both active trades had next-Friday expiry, suggested a 40% stop to anyone insisting on an exit, and accepted the possibility of continuing to hold into the next day. This combines a percentage stop reference with discretionary multi-session holding.
